verdict.rationale: HubSpot's official MCP server gives any MCP-compatible agent read and write access to CRM data including deals and engagements, which cover emails and meetings. That lets an agent read activity signals and write deal updates. Separately, HubSpot's own AI advertises 'smart deal progression' that keeps deals moving after every call with next steps handled, plus approvable automatic CRM updates after every meeting. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of updating the deal stage and next-step fields via the deals API or MCP tools, a documented signal-to-stage workflow for external agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
